name: Session Timer
description: Tracks and displays the total session duration when Claude stops working
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Track and display session duration
TIMER_FILE="/tmp/claude-session-start"
if [[ -f "$TIMER_FILE" ]]; then
  START=$(cat "$TIMER_FILE")
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  ELAPSED=$((NOW - START))
  MINS=$((ELAPSED / 60))
  SECS=$((ELAPSED % 60))
  echo "Session duration: ${MINS}m ${SECS}s"
  rm -f "$TIMER_FILE"
else
  date +%s > "$TIMER_FILE"
fi
exit 0
